decisions.reason: As a prominently launched and strategically core digital workflow extension, it likely stays because an established firm with some slack would tolerate uncertainty while results appear close enough to aspiration.
This education offering is more peripheral to the software core, so if its results are only modest management is likely to reallocate resources once it falls short of aspiration.
A remote support tool is tightly complementary to the firm's installed software base, so even with limited visibility it likely remains because it supports customer service and retention.
The analytics dashboard fits the firm's core product logic, and a mature firm would usually keep such a recent extension on the market unless performance clearly misses aspiration.
A complete practice bundle is closely tied to the established business and likely useful for cross-selling, so management would usually retain it unless evidence of failure became strong.
A jobs and practice portal is the weakest fit with the firm's main software activities, so under behavioral search it is the most likely product to be withdrawn if performance lags aspiration.
